# A scientist who builds data systems. {.hero-headline .unnumbered .unlisted}

::: {.hero-credentials}
Applied Data Scientist · MDS · MSc · RPBio
:::

::: {.hero-tagline}
I turn messy scientific data into trustworthy systems, models, and decisions.
:::

My background spans scientific research, six years of environmental consulting, and modern data science and machine learning. I work across the data lifecycle: understanding how measurements are generated, building reproducible pipelines, developing statistical and machine-learning models, deploying them, and communicating results to the people who depend on them.
